summary: Iteration 2 additive-feature testing: /api/settings (GET public, PUT admin-only), /api/products/{id}/reviews (GET/POST public), frontend Admin Paramètres tab, Reviews UI on ProductDetail, Checkout Alger-only wilaya + settings-driven delivery/payment. Backend: 7/7 pytest passed. Frontend: all critical flows work via SPA nav. One minor cart-persistence bug discovered on hard reload of /commande.

ui_bugs.issue: Race condition between the two useEffects: on mount, effect#2 writes the initial empty `items=[]` to localStorage BEFORE effect#1's setItems(saved) triggers a re-render. On a HARD reload of /commande (or any deep-link), localStorage 'pharma360_cart' is briefly clobbered to '[]' and the Checkout page early-returns 'Votre panier est vide'. Repro: add product to cart, then in a new tab or via full page reload open /commande directly — cart appears empty. Fix: guard the persistence effect with a `hydrated` ref/state, e.g. only write to LS after the load-from-LS effect has run.

action_items: Fix CartContext hydration race: only persist items to localStorage AFTER initial load-from-LS effect completes (add a `hydrated` ref). Prevents cart wipe on hard-refresh / deep-linking to /commande.
critical_code_review_comments: CartContext.jsx: two unguarded useEffects create the LS clobber race described above.
server.py update_settings: silently ignores unknown keys (good) but does not validate types (e.g. delivery_fee could be a string). Consider a Pydantic model similar to ReviewInput.
server.py add_review: reviews are fully public with no rate-limiting and no per-user uniqueness — spam risk in production; consider light throttling or captcha in a later iteration.

success_rate.frontend: ~90% (all core flows OK; 1 minor race bug on hard reload)

seed_data_creation: Added 2 test reviews on the first seeded product (names prefixed TEST_Alice, TEST_Bob). Settings were mutated during tests then restored to defaults (brand_name=Pharma360, delivery_fee=500, payment_cod_enabled=true, payment_card_enabled=true) as instructed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend endpoints /api/settings and /api/products/{id}/reviews are stable. Reuse /app/backend/tests/test_settings_reviews.py for regression. Frontend: SPA navigation works fine everywhere; the only observed defect is a CartContext hydration race that only manifests on hard reload of /commande. Iteration 1 tests (40) were not re-run as instructed.
rca of the issue: CartContext defines two useEffects: (1) load from localStorage on mount [] deps, (2) persist items to localStorage on every items change [items] deps. On mount both effects run in declaration order after the first commit; effect#2 fires with items=[] and overwrites LS to '[]' before React re-renders with the state produced by effect#1's setItems(saved). Meanwhile the Checkout page's early-return `if (items.length === 0) return <EmptyState/>` snapshots the empty-state UI and, combined with the LS clobber, results in the observed empty-cart screen on a hard refresh. Mitigation: introduce a `hydrated` boolean state that is set to true only after the load effect runs; gate the persist effect on `hydrated===true`. Alternatively initialise useState with a lazy initializer that reads localStorage synchronously, eliminating both effects being needed for hydration.
